title: Chapter 653 - 653 Kind-Hearted; Regretful!

Chapter 653 - 653 Kind-Hearted; Regretful!

Chapter 653 - 653 Kind-Hearted; Regretful!

653 Kind-Hearted; Regretful!

The three students on duty seemed to have heard the sound and turned to look into the woods.

However, it was early in the morning and the forest was dark. How could they see anything?

The three of them looked at each other with puzzled expressions.

After a moment of hesitation, the man in the black T-shirt said, “Should we go and take a look?”

“Let’s see,” the man in the checkered shirt on the left said hesitantly.

“Then let’s be careful,” the man on the right wearing silver-rimmed glasses said.

Thus, the three of them tiptoed forward slowly.

However, after walking for a while, they did not find anything.

“There doesn’t seem to be anything unusual,” said the man in the black T-shirt.

“It stinks. What’s that?” the man with silver-rimmed glasses said.

“Shit! F*ck! Who pooped here? Moreover, it’s all over the place! It’s as if they had rolled around in shit!”

“Go, go quickly!” The man in the checkered shirt resisted the urge to vomit and shouted.

Compared to the caution and vigilance they had when they came here, where they had to look three times with every step they took, the three of them were sprinting now. They were eager to leave in the shortest time possible.

At this moment, Chen Ming was hiding behind a big tree. He only heaved a sigh of relief when the three of them were far away.

He looked at the yellow stains on his hand and could not help but retch. He said angrily, “Pray that I never find out who you are!”

Then, Chen Ming looked at the yellow stains on his clothes and retched again. “My body is full of shit now. I can’t let Xia Xue see me like this. I have to go back to the city to take a shower and change my clothes!”

After saying that, he quickly turned around and ran into the forest.

On the other hand, Li Dongqiang had quietly returned to his sleeping bag.

He thought to himself, ‘Cutting off a person’s future is like killing one’s parents. I only beat him up and let him get smeared with a little shit. As expected, I’m still very kind, hehe.’

The corners of Li Dongqiang’s mouth curled up slightly as he slowly entered a beautiful dream.

He thought that what he did was very secretive and no one knew.

In fact…

Everything that had happened and even his thoughts were all seen and heard by Lin Fan.

Lin Fan laughed in his heart, ‘This Li Dongqiang is really interesting, hahaha!’

Instantly, Lin Fan’s good impression of Li Dongqiang rose rapidly.

Li Dongqiang still did not know how much benefit this good impression would bring him in the future.

…

In the blink of an eye, the next day arrived.

After the students got out of their sleeping bags, they were as energetic as yesterday morning.

They chatted with each other and laughed from time to time, looking very relaxed.

“Our Class 2011 is really lucky to have met Vice President Chen Ming.”

“With Vice President Chen Ming leading the way, our trip to the forbidden area will definitely be very safe. We might really be able to obtain some benefits.”

As they spoke, they looked at Chen Ming’s sleeping bag.

However, they soon became confused.

“Huh? Where’s Vice President Chen Ming?”

“Did he wake up so early?”

“I woke up very early and didn’t see Vice President Chen Ming.”

“What’s wrong?”

Gradually, more and more people were puzzled.

Following that, someone suggested organizing students to look for Chen Ming.

After all, it was definitely a big deal for someone to disappear for no reason.

Moreover, the person who disappeared was the vice president of the student union.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “There’s no need to look for him.”

Everyone looked at him in confusion.

Lin Fan said, “He left last night.”

As he spoke, a 3D projection appeared in front of him.

In the projection, there was an extremely disheveled man. It was Chen Ming.

At this moment, Chen Ming’s body was covered in yellow stains.

Then, he whispered, “My body is full of shit now. I can’t let Xia Xue see me like this. I have to go back to the city to take a shower and change my clothes!”

As soon as he finished speaking, the entire scene fell silent.

Many of them were trembling, their faces were flushed red. They were on the verge of laughing out loud.

In fact, when everyone saw the yellow stains on Chen Ming’s body, they had some guesses in their hearts.

However, after Chen Ming admitted it himself, the situation was obviously different.

At this moment, the man in the checkered shirt whispered, “Yesterday, I figured someone had stepped on shit. So it was Chen Ming…”

As his voice fell, the silence was finally broken.

“Hahaha!”

“He was covered in shit.”

“Hahahaha!”

“Chen Ming is so careless.”

The few of them could not help but laugh out loud.

Their laughter seemed to have ignited the scene.

Gradually, everyone started laughing.

After a while, Zhang Fen cleared his throat. He tried his best to suppress the urge to laugh and said, “It’s getting late. Let’s continue on our way.”

Without Chen Ming…

Li Dongqiang dealt with two snakes in the morning and received four words of thanks from his classmates, thus earning him four gratitude tokens.

Then, he used four gratitude tokens to draw the lottery and obtained 15 pounds worth of strength.

Li Dongqiang felt the power growing in his body and could not help but feel that it was definitely the right thing to do to chase Chen Ming away.

In the blink of an eye, a few days passed.

In the past few days, Li Dongqiang had driven away two wild boars and two poisonous snakes.

In addition, he had helped three female students carry their bags and helped a student on duty.

As a result, he received 13 gratitude tokens.

These 13 gratitude tokens had increased Li Dongqiang’s strength by 40 pounds worth.

They were still in the forest.

All the students had a bit of dirt on their faces, except Xia Xue.

Even Xia Xue herself felt puzzled.

Why was it that after walking in the forbidden area for a few days, she did not feel tired at all and there was not a trace of dirt on her body?

It was as if she had just arrived at the forbidden area.

However, she did not feel too happy because of this. A look of faint regret hung on her beautiful face.

Lin Fan could sense this and asked, “Xia Xue, why do you seem a little unhappy? Are you tired?”

Xia Xue shook her head. “I’m not tired.”

After a pause, she continued, “It’s just that… I heard that there’s a chance to become a special ability user in the forbidden area. There are only two days left before we leave the forbidden area, but we haven’t found anything special yet. I’m afraid we wasted this opportunity to enter the forbidden area.”

After that, Xia Xue sighed secretly.

A chance to become a special ability user?

Lin Fan’s eyes flickered.

Lin Fan took in a deep breath.

In the next moment, a hurricane suddenly appeared at the scene.

Then, a white energy that was visible to the naked eye rushed over and enveloped everyone.

With every breath, everyone’s strength would increase rapidly!

Everyone’s hearts were beating like drums, filled with tyrannical power.
